name: dartive
desc:
dartive (dart + rive): a from-scratch Dart scene-graph/game-action/state
library, grown out of products/squishy-mascot-twin's hand-rolled
puppet rendering. Pre-1.0 "seed" stage — see this package's own
.context/decisions/0001-dartive-seed-genesis.md for what that means.

name: IsoCamera
desc: A fixed-elevation isometric camera, rotatable around the vertical axis.

name: IsoCamera.new
desc:
Builds the basis for azimuthDegrees (α, measured in the x–z plane
from +x toward +z). Elevation is fixed; see the class contract.

name: forward
desc:
The viewing direction (camera toward origin), −c. Projection
discards exactly this component; VoxelPuppetPainter uses p·forward
as depth (larger = farther) and n·forward ≥ 0 to cull back faces.

name: projectOrthographic
desc:
Π(p) = scale·(right·p, −up·p) — projects a 3D point onto 2D screen
space by dropping its component along forward entirely (no
perspective divide) and keeping its components along right/up.
screenY is negated because screen coordinates grow downward while
up points toward positive world Y.

name: right
desc:
Screen-right in world space: (sin α, 0, −cos α). Always horizontal
(right.y == 0), so world height never shifts a point sideways.

name: up
desc:
Screen-up in world space: right × forward. Its y component is
cos ε, so a point raised by h moves up the screen by h·cos ε·scale.

name: JoystickDirection
desc:
Extracted into dartive from
products/my-astronaut-run-item/lib/screens/touch_joystick.dart —
that product's own .context/decisions/0021-restore-joystick-axis-labels.md/
0020/0018/0010 carry the full history of why it works this way
(reasoning that stays valid here unchanged). Every my-*-run-item
product to date has needed its own grid-walk joystick; this is the
first time it's shared rather than re-copied. See
.context/decisions/0012-maze-and-joystick-extraction.md.
One of the 4 grid directions a touch drag can report — never
diagonal.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: MazeGenerator
desc:
A static, generated rectangular maze — one particular kind of
Tilemap: a walled one. Extracted into dartive after the same
recursive-backtracker algorithm had been hand-copied and re-adapted
across three products in a row — my-rownie-run-item's original,
ported into my-atlas-run-item's MazeBoard, then into
my-astronaut-run-item's own MazeGenerator (square size only) —
before raon-runner-platform-mockup/apps/maze-run-demo's village
board needed a rectangular (20×10) board and made the duplication
worth stopping. Extends Tilemap (not a separate concept from
it) since the user asked for the "open board" case — a village with
no walls — not to be confused with "a maze," the same distinction
my-atlas-run-item's RunBoard.isMaze flag already drew between
MazeBoard and AtlasRunBoard. See
.context/decisions/0012-maze-and-joystick-extraction.md and
0014-tilemap-extraction.md.
Standard "recursive backtracker" over the chambers at even
coordinates; every odd-coordinate cell starts as a wall, and a wall
slot between two chambers is removed exactly when the carve reaches
between them. A fixed seed, so this is one learnable maze,
identical every load — not regenerated per session. Pure Dart, no
Flutter dependency, so it's directly unit-testable
(agent-harness-patterns.md's "keep state and rendering separate,"
applied one layer further down than usual).

name: MazeGenerator.new
desc:
width/height must both be even for the chamber/wall scheme to
tile cleanly (every my-*-run-item board to date has used an even
size; this scaffold keeps that assumption rather than silently
rounding). size is kept as a convenience for a square board,
matching the ported original's constructor shape.

name: isWall
desc:
false everywhere unless a wall function was given — an open
tilemap (a village) simply never passes one.

name: wallCells
desc:
Every wall cell after carving: all odd-coordinate cells except the
wall slots the carve removed. Read-only in intent; isWall reads it.

name: RearmableTimer
desc:
A Timer that can be re-armed (cancel the pending firing and schedule a
new one) without the caller hand-tracking a nullable Timer? field and
repeating the _timer?.cancel(); _timer = Timer(...) dance. Pure
dart:async — no Riverpod, no scheduling policy of its own; the
caller still decides durations and callbacks, arm/cancel are just
the lifecycle plumbing.

name: arm
desc: Cancels any pending firing and schedules callback after duration.

name: cancel
desc: Cancels any pending firing. Safe to call when nothing is armed.

name: Tilemap
desc:
A rectangular (width×height) grid of cells a character can stand
on and move across, with a per-cell walkable/blocked check — the
convergent shape every *Board class in this factory already
reinvents on its own: RunBoard/MazeBoard/AtlasRunBoard
(my-atlas-run-item, isMaze flag distinguishing a walled board
from an open one), PartnerBoard (my-astronaut-run-item, always
open), ExplorerBoard (voxel-explorer-spike, open + zone-tinted).
None of those were built from this — this is the first time the
shape itself is shared.

name: Tilemap.new
desc: A width×height tilemap; omit isWall for an open one.

name: height
desc: Number of rows along z; valid z is 0..height-1.

name: inBounds
desc: Whether (x, z) ∈ Ω, i.e. 0 <= x < width && 0 <= z < height.

name: isWall
desc:
false everywhere unless a wall function was given — an open
tilemap (a village) simply never passes one.

name: width
desc: Number of columns along x; valid x is 0..width-1.

name: TouchJoystickCanvas
desc:
Wraps child (the map canvas) with a touch-to-summon virtual
joystick: touching the canvas and dragging past a small reveal
threshold shows a base+knob anchored at the touch-down point,
reporting one of the 4 JoystickDirections. A touch that never
exceeds the reveal threshold (an ordinary tap) never shows anything.

name: TouchJoystickCanvas.new
desc: Wraps child; see the class doc for the gesture contract.

name: child
desc: The canvas the joystick is summoned over.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: onDirection
desc:
Called once when the drag first crosses the deadzone in a
direction (measured from the touch-down anchor, not the knob's own
travel), then repeatedly on a fixed interval for as long as it's
held there — holding should feel like holding an arrow key down.

name: onDragActiveChanged
desc:
Called with true the instant the reveal threshold is crossed (the
moment the joystick actually becomes visible and controlling),
false on release/cancel. A touch that never reveals the joystick
never calls this at all.

name: zoneAzimuthOffsetDegrees
desc:
Rotates the hit-test zone boundaries (and the visible axis labels
with them) by this many degrees clockwise from their default
screen-aligned position (up/right/down/left).

name: Vec3
desc:
An immutable vector v = (x, y, z) ∈ ℝ³ in world space, with the
factory's right-handed axes: +x right, +y up, +z forward.

name: Vec3.new
desc: Creates v = (x, y, z).

name: add
desc: a + b, componentwise.

name: cross
desc:
a × b (LA-3): orthogonal to both, right-handed, with
‖a × b‖ = ‖a‖‖b‖ sin θ. Anticommutative:
a × b = −(b × a).

name: dot
desc:
a·b = aₓbₓ + a_yb_y + a_zb_z (LA-2). Zero iff orthogonal;
for a unit b, the signed length of a's projection onto b.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: length
desc: ‖v‖ = √(v·v), the Euclidean (L2) norm.

name: normalize
desc:
v / ‖v‖, a unit vector (LA-4). The zero vector has no
direction and is returned unchanged rather than producing NaN.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: scale
desc: s·v, componentwise.

name: subtract
desc: a − b, componentwise.

name: x
desc: The component along +x (screen-right at azimuth 0).

name: y
desc:
The component along +y (world up; the only axis IsoCamera's
elevation tilts toward).

name: z
desc: The component along +z (world forward).

name: VoxelPuppet
desc:
A sparse grid of colored unit cubes — a puppet built out of voxels
instead of bones/parts. State only: knows nothing about how it gets
drawn (see VoxelPuppetPainter in voxel_puppet_painter.dart) — same
state/render split as every other product in this factory. Coordinates
are grid-cell indices (0..size-1 per axis), not world units.

name: VoxelPuppet.new
desc: An empty puppet on a size³ grid.

name: at
desc: V(x,y,z), or null where undefined (empty or out of bounds).

name: clear
desc: Removes every voxel and notifies listeners.

name: inBounds
desc: Whether (x,y,z) ∈ [0,size)³.

name: set
desc:
Sets color at a cell unconditionally, in bounds or not a no-op
otherwise — unlike toggle, never removes an existing voxel. Used by
voxelPuppetFromJson and by callers hand-authoring a fixed shape
(e.g. a sample creature), where "set this exact cell" is the intent,
not "flip whatever's here."

name: size
desc: Edge length of the cubic grid; valid coordinates are 0..size-1.

name: toggle
desc: Places color at an empty cell, or removes whatever's already there.

name: voxels
desc: Every defined cell and its color — an unmodifiable view.

name: VoxelPuppetIo
desc:
Serialization for VoxelPuppet — plain JSON (grid size + a flat list
of {x,y,z,color} cells), not a Dart-source literal or a binary
format: any consuming product can parse this with nothing but
dart:convert, no extra dependency beyond dartive itself.

name: toJson
desc:
toJsonMap encoded with 2-space indentation. Round-trips through
voxelPuppetFromJson (VOX-4).

name: toJsonMap
desc: {size, voxels: [{x, y, z, color: '#AARRGGBB'}]} as a decoded map.

name: VoxelPuppetPainter
desc:
Renders a VoxelPuppet as flat-shaded, depth-sorted unit cubes under a
given camera — backface-culled, and faces fully hidden by a
neighboring voxel are skipped before that, so this stays cheap even at
a puppet's full grid size. camera is a constructor parameter, not a
fixed field, so the same puppet can be painted from several angles at
once (see products/voxel-asset-bakery's multi-view panel for a
consumer that does exactly that).

name: VoxelPuppetPainter.new
desc: Paints puppet through camera, repainting whenever it notifies.

name: camera
desc: The projection Π used for every corner and for depth/culling.

name: includeVoxel
desc:
Restricts which voxels' faces this painter actually draws —
hidden-face culling still checks the full puppet regardless
(a voxel's neighbor is still "there" for culling purposes even
when this filter excludes it from being drawn by this particular
painter). Null (default) draws every visible face, unchanged from
this class's original behavior.

name: paint
desc:
Called whenever the object needs to paint. The given Canvas has its
coordinate space configured such that the origin is at the top left of the
box. The area of the box is the size of the size argument.

name: puppet
desc: The voxel state to draw (also this painter's repaint listenable).

name: scale
desc: Pixels per world unit, passed to IsoCamera.projectOrthographic.

name: shouldRepaint
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: dipAndRecoverPulse
desc:
1.0 outside the pulse window, dipping to 0.0 and back as elapsed runs
from zero to rising + falling — a brief "close, then reopen" shape.
Ordering matches Rive's own "Interpolation on States": a value eased
into a state, then eased back out, driven by however the caller
decides when the pulse starts (a timer, a trigger — dartive stays
pure math, no scheduling; see this package's own CLAUDE.md).

name: gridBfsPath
desc:
Breadth-first shortest path over a 4-connected integer grid — the
standard unweighted-graph shortest-path algorithm, scoped
specifically to "a small rectangular grid, 4-directional movement,
every edge the same length," which is what a mini-game board
typically is. Not a general graph library.

name: isoTileCenter
desc:
The screen point for the center of unit cell (x, z) — the usual
anchor for a marker (avatar, pickup, prop) sitting on that cell,
rather than one of its corners.

name: isoTileCorners
desc:
The 4 corners of one unit cell (x, z) of a ground-plane grid (y
fixed at 0), projected through camera — in order
(x,z) → (x+1,z) → (x+1,z+1) → (x,z+1), ready to build a quad for an
isometric floor/wall tile. origin shifts the whole projection (e.g.
to center a board on a canvas); scale matches
IsoCamera.projectOrthographic's own scale.

name: isoTilePath
desc: The same 4 corners as a closed Path, ready for canvas.drawPath.

name: perspectiveTurnX
desc:
The up/down sibling of perspectiveTurnY: rotateX turns around the
horizontal axis — like a trunk lid hinged front-to-back — so the
visible motion is a tilt/nod (up/down), not left/right.

name: perspectiveTurnY
desc:
A perspective "card flip" matrix that fakes a rotateY head/body turn
for a flat 2D puppet with no real mesh — setEntry(3, 2, depth) adds
the projective divide a plain rotateY lacks, so the far side visually
compresses instead of just shearing. Apply around the part's own local
origin (translate first, then canvas.transform(matrix.storage)).

name: voxelPuppetFromJson
desc:
Rebuilds a VoxelPuppet from VoxelPuppetIo.toJson's output (or an
equivalent hand-written JSON asset).
